item.title: Are You Getting Ahead of the Medicine? - The Power Path
item.description: In Native American understanding there is a concept called ‘getting ahead of the medicine’. This is an extremely useful idea. To understand the meaning of this term it helps to understand what a native person means by Medicine. Medicine is a term used by indigenous peoples around the world to refer to a person’s unique talents and abilities.

item.title: March, 2026 Monthly Forecast - The Power Path

This month will require flexibility, acceptance, neutrality and enthusiasm around what is possible rather than despair in difficult situations. item.title: Full Moon Update ~ March 3, 2026 - The Power Path
item.description: A Full Moon in Virgo with a total Lunar Eclipse is Tuesday, March 3 at 4:37AM Mountain Standard Time (MST). Part of the Blood Moon cycle of eclipses, this one exposes what needs to be seen. That which is hidden comes to light and a clearer path opens up that may include radical change, necessary endings, and great creativity and inspiration around all the possibilities opening up. It is time for a new story but first the old one needs to be complete and the page turned.

item.title: New Moon and Equinox Update ~ March 18, 2026 - The Power Path
item.description: The New Moon in Pisces is Wednesday, March 18 at 7:23 PM Mountain Daylight Time (MDT). This is truly a time of new beginnings and in order to take advantage of the opportunity for a big reset several things need to be considered. Are you still holding on to an old dream? Are you acknowledging what you need to let go of before moving into a new landscape in your life? This is a fertile time to focus on what is possible instead of regretting the past or feeling ambivalent about the future.
